verdict.rationale: llamafile is launched directly as an executable from the command line. Its CLI reference documents a `--server` mode with HTTP server, API, Web UI and slot options, and the quickstart shows the resulting local server at localhost:8080. A community user also praises the 'CLI interface and web server' UX. missing for 10: documented stop/shutdown behavior or command (stopping is only implied by ending the process), and detailed hands-on corroboration of the server start/stop lifecycle.
